potency-catch-partridge.title: Catch a male partridge
potency-catch-partridge.description: Catch a named live bird or animal as a remedy ingredient.
potency-catch-partridge.matchRule: Catch a live animal named as a remedy ingredient; record species and season on the occurrence.

potency-pluck-strangle.title: Pluck and strangle the partridge
potency-pluck-strangle.description: Pluck a bird and kill it for use as a remedy ingredient.
potency-pluck-strangle.matchRule: Pluck and kill a bird whose body becomes a remedy ingredient, not an offering.

potency-salt-dry.title: Salt and dry the bird
potency-salt-dry.description: Salt or smear an ingredient and dry it.
potency-salt-dry.matchRule: Salt and dry a remedy ingredient before crushing.

potency-crush-with-thorn.title: Crush with thorn seed
potency-crush-with-thorn.description: Crush dried ingredients together into a powder.
potency-crush-with-thorn.matchRule: Crush named dried ingredients for a remedy.

potency-drink-in-beer.title: Give it to drink in beer
potency-drink-in-beer.description: Give a crushed remedy to the patient to drink in a named liquid.
potency-drink-in-beer.matchRule: Give a prepared remedy to the patient to drink; record the liquid (beer, water, wine) on the occurrence.

potency-blood-into-water.title: Let the blood fall into water
potency-blood-into-water.description: Let the blood of an animal fall into water to make a remedy.
potency-blood-into-water.matchRule: Drain animal blood into water as a remedy base.

potency-water-under-stars.title: Leave the water under the stars
potency-water-under-stars.description: Leave a liquid remedy out overnight under the stars.
potency-water-under-stars.matchRule: Leave a remedy outdoors overnight; the stars or night must be stated.

potency-wrap-in-wool.title: Wrap in wool
potency-wrap-in-wool.description: Wrap remedy ingredients in wool as a bundle to be worn or placed.
potency-wrap-in-wool.matchRule: Wrap remedy ingredients in wool; record the source of the wool.

potency-smear-salt-plant.title: Smear with salt and nīnû-plant
potency-smear-salt-plant.description: Smear a bird with salt and a named plant before drying.
potency-smear-salt-plant.matchRule: Smear an ingredient with salt and a plant before drying it.

potency-mix-roasted-flour.title: Mix with roasted-grain flour
potency-mix-roasted-flour.description: Mix a crushed ingredient with flour.
potency-mix-roasted-flour.matchRule: Mix a crushed remedy ingredient with a named flour.

potency-form-pellets.title: Form pellets
potency-form-pellets.description: Crush ingredients, mix with flour and shape into pellets.
potency-form-pellets.matchRule: Shape a crushed remedy mixture into pellets.

potency-bind-on-hips.title: Bind on the hips
potency-bind-on-hips.description: Tie a remedy bundle on the patient’s body.
potency-bind-on-hips.matchRule: Tie or bind a prepared bundle onto a named part of the patient’s body.

potency-rinse-body.title: Rinse with water and kasû
potency-rinse-body.description: Rinse the patient’s body with water and a plant.
potency-rinse-body.matchRule: Rinse the patient’s whole body with a named liquid and plant.

potency-anoint-oil.title: Anoint repeatedly with oil
potency-anoint-oil.description: Rub oil containing a remedy onto the patient.
potency-anoint-oil.matchRule: Anoint the patient with a named oil or remedy.

potency-sumerian-incantation.title: Recite the Sumerian incantation
potency-sumerian-incantation.description: Recite a prescribed incantation as part of a medical prescription.
potency-sumerian-incantation.matchRule: Recite an incantation belonging to a medical prescription.

potency-crush-decoct-sinews.title: Crush and decoct the sinews
potency-crush-decoct-sinews.description: Crush animal parts between stones and boil them down.
potency-crush-decoct-sinews.matchRule: Crush remedy ingredients and decoct them.
